topic: Project standstill, dispute and EPPO investigation (2025-2026)
wiki_text: The Vasilikos LNG import project (owner ETYFA, a DEFA subsidiary) was at a standstill as of January 2026. The FSRU Etyfa Prometheas (ex Galea) was delivered on 9 December 2024; Lloyd's Register issued an LNGC certificate identifying 12 outstanding works that can only be completed once the Vasilikos pier is finished and LNG is available. Onshore facilities, especially the pier, remained incomplete. A new project manager, Technip, was appointed to investigate the project's status. ETYFA and the construction contractor, the CPP-Metron Consortium (CMC), entered arbitration in London, with CMC asserting the vessel was ready and that ETYFA had refused delivery. Both the LNG import project and the related GSI electricity interconnector were under investigation by the European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) for suspected fraud and corruption. Sources framed the need for gas to be available before the end of 2027, with no firm commissioning date established.
